p: Achmetha: In which were the acts of the kings of the Medes and Persians.
brought again unto the temple which: Meaning Zerubbabel to whom he gives charge.
from thence: Meddle not with them neither hinder them.
not hindered: For lack of money.
to dwell there destroy all kings: Who has appointed that place to have his Name called on there.
Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the: Whom God stirs up to assure them that he would give their work good success.
Adar: This is the twelfth month and contains part of February and part of March.
the sixth year of the reign: The 42nd year after their first return.
separated themselves unto them from the: Who were of the heathen and forsook their idolatry to worship the true God.
Assyria unto them: Meaning Darius who was king of the Medes, Persians and Assyrians.
